missions: Clear event stages 10 times, not including tutorial stages.
Clear event stages 25 times, not including tutorial stages.
Clear event stages 40 times, not including tutorial stages.

list:
Iconic Kjerag design - huge capacity, resistant to wind and dust. 
But, it would be a huge shame to just let this pair of skis sit here. Let's go skiing.

A classic Kjerag loom that some inns will put out for tourists to try. Finished products can be taken home, but you still have to pay for the materials.
The history of the loom goes back too far for us to know who invented it, but the Kjerag people have come to regard it as a gift from Kjeragandr.

A piece of iconic Kjerag furniture, pairing the sturdiest wood with the softest fabrics - a place you can't wait to return to every night. 
The sun passes over the snow and sprinkles down over the headboard. The elder rings the bell there, signaling the start of a new day.

Fur rugs, thick and soft, made with Kjerag's traditional craftsmanship. 
How would you sum up life in Kjerag in only a few words? A warm rug, a lit hearth, drifting snow, and hot tea.

Thick blankets hang from wooden racks to keep the cold from seeping through the roof. If the temperature drops, the blanket can be removed to provide warmth.
Civilization continues to move forward, but some wisdom persists through the ages.

A modern lamp, specifically reinforced to make it into the style of a chandelier. 
It may take a long time for Kjerag to develop into Victoria, but there will always be someone working on it.

Wooden herb racks seen in homes around Kjerag. The people keep dried herbs on hand, in case of emergency. 
A faint scent lingers by the window. Before the advent of modern medicine throughout the region, these herbs were the most effective cures.

Post station-style floorboards, adapted with Kjerag themes more familiar to the locals. 
From these places, the outside world came to know of the region known as Kjerag.
'What's on the other side of the mountain? Another mountain? Another you?'
theme: Rhodes Island's reproduction of a room at an inn near the Silverash territory's railway station.

list:
You stopped the avalanche. 
The winter sunlight pours across the land of Kjerag, laughter fills the air, and everything seems to be developing in a better direction. However, as you know well, the snow will continue to fall, and avalanches... will happen again and again.
Clear BI-8 with a 3-star rating before the second blizzard arrives.

You are a true master of snowfield combat tactics. 
The purpose of training each Tschäggättä team was to realize your goals. And obviously, you still have some energy left.
During the 'Break the Ice' event, obtain Operator Kjera.

You have gained Her favor. 
God does not exist, but God also does exist. When She looks across Her dominion, not a soul knows whether She will be proud or bewildered.
During the 'Break the Ice' event, spend a total of 2,400 Stones of Kjeragandr at [Turicam Trade Zone].

You've become a VIP of the Karlan Trade Company. 
Even without being personal friends with Enciodes, the vast amount of money you spent at the Kjerag Exchange is enough to get premium suites at Karlan. You might even consider trying to compete with Enciodes, which may not be a bad option either.
Complete all the content in [Kjerag Guidebook] and collect the rewards.

You've walked the streets and alleyways of Kjerag. 
You've discovered that modern technology has gradually spread through this small country, and perhaps by your next visit, the entire country will be transformed. Whether that's a good or a bad thing, you can't say for sure.
Complete all stages in [The Grand Ceremony] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials).

Your trip to Kjerag took an unexpected turn. 
Or perhaps, that was what you expected all along?
Clear BI-5 while making at least 3 Icefield Arts Fighter fall.

You've learned some tricks from the hunters who live in isolation in the mountains.
Snow conceals many things—conspiracies, bloodstains, and of course... traps.
Complete all stages in [Holy Hunt] on Challenge Mode.

Your prestige has spread to every corner of Kjerag. 
The people believe that none are worthier to serve as Enciodes's right hand than you, and as both you and Enciodes know, you both are looking forward to your next contest.

You succeeded in containing Degenbrecher. 
An army of one holds ten-thousand at the pass. You should be thankful that she isn't your enemy after all.
Clear BI-EX-2 while making at least 10 enemies fall.

Your ability to toy with your prey upon the snowfield is an artform. 
Under your guidance, they may even believe that they chose to walk into your trap, and that you are a mere bystander.
set: Break the Ice Engraved Medal Set

An engraved medal set that records the incidents within the snowy mountains. 
We have grown accustomed to enjoying the conveniences of modernity, but rarely experience the throes of transformation. 
When faced with change, people always end up making different decisions—and the same is true for Enciodes and Enya.
